chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musanna, from Fitr ibn Khaleefa, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father, may the prayers of Allah be upon them, said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever repels from a group of Muslims an adversity of water or fire, Paradise is obligated for him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for protecting Muslims from water and fire?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of the Ahl al-Bayt in al-Kafi, emphasizes the communal obligation (fard kifaya) of safeguarding the Muslim community from specific natural adversities like water and fire. It underscores the spiritual merit of proactive protection, promising Paradise to the individual who successfully repels these dangers, reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical service to the Ummah as a path to divine reward.
